name: Asian American and Pacific Islander Studies

AAPI 198.desc: Directed group study by special arrangement with a faculty member on a topic or in a field not included in the regular AAPI studies program curriculum.

AAPI 87.desc: The First-year Seminar Program is designed to provide new students with the opportunity to explore an intellectual topic with a faculty member in a small seminar setting. First-year seminars can be offered in all campus departments and undergraduate colleges, and topics vary from quarter to quarter.
